name: identity_trusted_devices
description: A browser that completed the second factor for a Person and asked to be remembered; its HttpOnly cookie holds a random token stored here only as SHA-256.
lifecycle: Valid while not revoked and younger than the policy's remember_device_days. Revoked by the Person, by password or second-factor changes, by an owner reset or disabling; expired rows are pruned.

columns.Meaning: Person whose second factor the browser completed.
SHA-256 of the 256-bit browser token; the token itself is never stored.
When the second factor was completed on this browser.
Last sign-in that skipped the second factor with this browser.
When the browser stopped being remembered.
columns.Null meaning: Still remembered while within the policy period.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES identity_persons(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
CREATE INDEX identity_trusted_devices_person_idx ON public.identity_trusted_devices USING btree (person_id)
constraints.Purpose: Revocation of a Person's remembered browsers.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_trusted_devices_token_key ON public.identity_trusted_devices USING btree (token_hash)
constraints.Purpose: Token lookup; one row per browser token.
